title: Replicating the 12-Model EM Universality Gap on a Single Open Model

original_idea.body: Disentangle EM non-replication from weak task acquisition at matched task accuracy.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: disentangling task-learning from EM resistance shows whether negative results give false safety.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Guided: LoRA on public dataset for two small models with task-accuracy control.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused: matched-task-accuracy EM comparison; one main confound to control.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Independent-friendly: public dataset/models, scrutiny of a recent negative result.

low_compute.reasoning: Two small LoRA fine-tunes (1-3B), single GPU.

novelty.reasoning: Builds on May-2026 paper; task-acquisition-confound test angle may be open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Recent paper reports the gap; testing the task-acquisition confound is a likely-open follow-up.
